final_report:
Fixed all button handlers in Sage web UI (T-fix-buttons).

ATTACH BUTTON (urgent) - sage-workspace.html:
- Added hidden <input type="file" id="file-input" hidden multiple accept=".pdf,.docx,.pptx,.md,.txt,.tex">
- Added hidden upload modal structure (#upload-modal, #upload-backdrop, #upload-close, #upload-zone, #upload-list, #upload-cancel, #upload-submit, #upload-status) with matching CSS (.modal, .modal_backdrop, .upload_zone etc) and aria attributes.
- Wired attach-btn click -> file-input click (direct picker). Wired upload-btn (sidebar) -> open_upload_modal.
- file-input change handler: if modal open, add to pending_files and render list; else direct handle_files_direct (FormData with multipart field  iles, POST /api/files, show composer-status, refresh files-list via GET /api/files).
- Added open_upload_modal/close_upload_modal, render_pending, add_pending_files, refresh_files_list, handle_files_direct, submit_upload.
- Added drag-drop on upload-zone (dragover/dragleave/drop -> add_pending_files + open modal) and on input-bar wrapper (dragover/drop -> direct upload).
- Added pending list UI with remove buttons, upload submit disabled until files selected, status messages.
- Added files-list click/keydown handlers, plan-nodes click handler, input-bar drag feedback.

INDEX.HTML:
- Added hidden file-input (same accept).
- Added index_attach_fix IIFE: attach-btn -> file-input click, file-input change -> handle_files (FormData  iles -> POST /api/files, status via composer-status, refresh sessions list), input-bar drag-drop. Added defensive hamburger/sidebar handlers with optional chaining.

SAGE-LIBRARY.HTML:
- Hardened toggleSidebar/close_sidebar with optional chaining and aria-expanded updates.
- Changed upload_btn/zone handlers to use ?.addEventListener, added keydown for zone, file_input change now resets value and uses ?. , made file-list delegation use ?. and fixed excerpts modal open/close to use ?. and aria. All multipart uses  iles (already correct). Verified drag-drop zone works.

SAGE-SESSIONS.HTML:
- Hardened toggle/close with ?. and aria, modal open/close use ?., new-session modal now disables Create button while creating, handles response status, resets input. Session list delegation now uses ?.addEventListener for click and keydown (Enter/Space) for keyboard accessibility. Delete handling already stops propagation.

SAGE-HEALTH.HTML:
- Hardened toggle/close, refresh-btn now uses ?.addEventListener with disabled state and innerHTML preservation, added aria-label, keydown handler. Escape handling preserved.

SAGE-SETTINGS.HTML:
